Hi Sofia — congrats and hang in there. First priority is you and your family; please focus on that.

Karthik / Mina — looping you both in. Given the circumstances we have three options, ordered by candidate preference:
1) Convert today's coding interview to the documented take-home and give Sofia 48 hours to submit. We would then reconvene for a 30-min live debrief with Karthik + Mina the following day or later this week. I can draft the take-home and send now.
2) If Sofia is able later today and wants to do a short behavioral screen (15–20m), I'm happy to hold a slack/phone slot as a backup; we should not expect a full systems deep-dive.
3) If neither works, cancel today's loop and reschedule full final panel next week.

For option 1, attached is the final-round agenda we planned; I'll also attach a concise take-home prompt and rubric. If we go take-home, please confirm whether you'd like to modify scope (Karthik/Mina).

Sofia — no pressure on timing. Once you know, reply here and we'll action. Wishing you the best.
